thread:
sam: Hey team, sam here. Day 1! Need a hand with cloud access: project id = redwood-apac-sam-1. Requesting: (1) GCP compute CPU quota in asia-northeast1 for short eval runs, (2) link to RWD-APAC billing account, (3) KMS decrypt access for SA model-run@redwood-apac-sam-1.iam.gserviceaccount.com, (4) AWS read-only role arn:arn:aws:iam::333222111000:role/RWD-Logs-Reader for S3 logs. Who should I loop in? :wave:

ops-bot: Created ticket GA-4902 for cloud onboarding. Please include exact billing account id and KMS key resource name. Cloud team hours 8am-6pm PT.

nina: welcome @sam! I can handle the KMS + quotas. For CPUs, confirm machine types (e2 vs n2) and roughly how many vCPUs. For KMS paste the resource: projects/.../locations/asia-northeast1/keyRings/.../cryptoKeys/....

sam: Thanks @nina. We'll start with n2-standard-8, need ~40 vCPUs initially. KMS key: projects/redwood-apac-sam-1/locations/asia-northeast1/keyRings/serve/cryptoKeys/run-key.

rachel: Billing here 4b0. Our APAC billing account is 04F5G6-APAC001. I can link it, but please confirm the onboarding checklist at https://redwood-internal.tools/onboarding/cloud-access and reply "link apac". Also do you want billing export to a workspace dataset?

sam: link apac 44d3fb and yes please export to billing_apac_sandbox. Adding AWS role ARN to GA-4902 now.

nina: Filed GCP quota increase for asia-northeast1 (40 vCPUs) and opened PD IOPS request (estimated 3-5 business days). I'll add IAM binding: service account model-run@redwood-apac-sam-1.iam.gserviceaccount.com -> roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on run-key. Example command I'll run (for audit):

```
# add KMS binding
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding run-key
  --location=asia-northeast1 --keyring=serve
  --member="serviceAccount:model-run@redwood-apac-sam-1.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
  --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
```

Note: I cannot link billing; rachel will do that.

ben: For AWS cross-account, I can help. Add the CI principal ARN that will assume the role. We require a Trust policy with source principal and optional external-id. Add the principal to GA-4902 and I'll configure the trust. No separate ticket needed.

infra-bot: Temporary dev role issued: roles/redwood.dev/temp/sam (expires in 5d). Use: gcloud auth login --impersonate-service-account=model-run@redwood-apac-sam-1.iam.gserviceaccount.com

rachel: linked billing account 04F5G6-APAC001 to project redwood-apac-sam-1. Enabled billing export to dataset billing_apac_sandbox. Please allow ~10 minutes for data to appear.

sam: Amazing, thanks everyone. Quick follow-ups: (1) any blocking org-policy that prevents creating external IPs in APAC? (2) when the AWS trust is ready, what command should CI use to assume role?

nina: (1) APAC has default deny for external IPs in prod; non-prod projects can request exceptions. If you need egress, ping me for NAT config. (2) ben will post the assume-role snippet once trust is set.

ben: I'll set up the trust tonight. CI can use aws sts assume-role:

```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::333222111000:role/RWD-Logs-Reader --role-session-name ci-session --duration-seconds 3600
```

I'll add the principal and external-id to GA-4902 and confirm when done.

sam: Added CI principal arn:arn:aws:sts::999000888777:assumed-role/ci-runner to the ticket. Thanks all, I'll start smoke tests tomorrow and report any infra issues. :rocket:
